description: Formal categorical bridge: the factor 2 in the proton mass formula equals |Orb_bar(triv)| = |{(3),(1,1,1)}| — the cardinality of the bar-involution orbit of the trivial rep in Irr(H₃(q)). This coincides with dim V_(2,1) at n=3 but is categorically the orbit size, not the standard-rep dimension.

categorical_statement.coincidence: equals dim V_(2,1) = n-1 = 2 at n=3 only
categorical_statement.mechanism: bar involution q↔q⁻¹ exchanges y₃↔y₁₁₁; writhe-0 pure braid makes χ=1 for both
